name: Crie Anabuki Inc.
summary: Crie Anabuki Inc. operates as a human resources service company in Japan. It offers temporary staffing, temporary to permanent placement, recruitment support, human resources consulting, training and assessment, and outplacement services, as well as business management or personnel management outsourcing services. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan. Crie Anabuki Inc. is a subsidiary of Anabuki Kosan Inc.
